name: 微纹理分析
description: Analyzes micro-level 文本ure patterns invisible to human eye
algorithm: Micro Texture Analysis — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes micro-level texture patterns for image forensic analysis following Haralick et al. (1973):

1. **Micro-纹理提取**: Fine-grained texture features are extracted at the pixel level using high-pass filtering and texture energy measurements. Micro-textures (texture details at the 1-5 pixel scale) capture the finest observable detail in the image.

2. **纹理Co-occurrence分析**: Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrices (GLCM) are computed at small displacements (1-3 pixels) in multiple directions. GLCM-derived features (contrast, correlation, energy, homogeneity, per Haralick et al.) characterize the micro-texture properties.

3. **Naturalvs.Synthetic纹理Discrimination**: Natural micro-textures arise from physical surface properties (material roughness, surface structure) filtered through the camera's imaging pipeline (lens MTF, sensor integration). AI-generated micro-textures arise from the generator's learned distribution. These differ in: (a) statistical higher-order moments, (b) directional properties, (c) scale-dependent behavior.

4. **Micro-纹理空间一致性**: The consistency of micro-texture statistics across the image is checked. All regions captured through the same camera show consistent micro-texture properties. Regions with different micro-texture statistics (e.g., a face with different micro-texture than the background) indicate potential manipulation or AI generation.

5. **纹理Authenticity评分**: Micro-texture features are combined into a forensic score. The score measures how well the observed micro-textures match expectations for natural imaging vs. AI generation, with region-specific scoring to highlight inconsistent areas.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： micro 文本ure analysis 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Haralick, R.M. et al. (1973). Textural Features for Image Classification. IEEE TSMC.
Corvi et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
